modern_index_text: law_names then article_numbers then original chunk text, newline separated; all chunks retained
smartcn_analyzer: Unmodified SmartChineseAnalyzer default punctuation stop set and bundled ICTCLAS dictionary; same token stream for documents and queries; no extra alnum filter or application dictionary
smartcn_query: Unique analyzed terms with OR semantics, no QueryParser, phrase, expansion, boost or reranker; maximum 65536 terms, reject overflow without truncation
native_engine: Lucene BM25Similarity(1.5,0.75,true); ByteBuffersDirectory; native byte-quantized document norms, nonempty-field document count and float scores; native score-desc then chunk_id UTF-8-asc sort before top-k
token_control_engine: BM25S 0.3.9 lucene/IDF-lucene numpy float64 on exactly the SmartCN token stream; document TF retained, query tokens unique; exact token length normalization with all input documents in average length and IDF population
selection: All three modern arms, including the SmartCN token control, are eligible candidates. Rank by development Hit@5, then MRR@5, then lower second-pass end-to-end query p95. Only Hit@5 AND MRR@5 at least the same-run legacy baseline meets the unchanged engineering promotion guard. No production/default promotion is performed by this experiment.
runtime_scope: Direct lexical ranking only, experimental Java helper; no production service integration, exact route, chat risk rule, generation, embedding, reranker or checker
timing_scope: Compile once before workers and record separately. One fresh process per arm, one fresh index/JVM per Java arm. Build includes analysis, JVM startup and IPC; query includes analysis and IPC. Two passes in forward/reverse case order. Native engine time is auxiliary, not end-to-end latency.
memory_scope: Sample simultaneous RSS sum of the worker and its live descendants at 20ms; includes JVM and Python, excludes prior javac preparation. A sampled process-tree maximum is not exact OS peak or exclusive index size.
network_boundary: Python socket audit guard in each benchmark process; Java helper contains only local file/stdio and Lucene code. No model client, Maven invocation or dependency download during the benchmark. This is not an OS-level air gap.
limits: 120 reused development cases; 108 retrieval-gold cases and 12 no-gold cases with NA ranking metrics, not inferred refusal successes
Independent human legal review and unseen holdout are absent; a third user-requested comparison adds selection bias
Native Lucene versus BM25S SmartCN differs in document norm quantization, float precision, field statistics and execution runtime; identical tokens do not imply identical scores
Historical versus modern differs in analyzer, index text and manual boosts; comparisons are not a single-factor BM25 formula claim
Fixed arm order, one cold build per arm and sampled memory do not establish production capacity; no API latency claim without per-run rebuild and database costs
No case-specific dictionaries, parameter tuning, gold rewriting or protocol changes after observing this run; preserve both earlier comparisons
Any arm error, timeout, identity drift, missing result or ranking repeat mismatch invalidates winner selection; preserve failures rather than assigning zero quality
